speaker: Elder David A. Bednar
title: Sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise
session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder David A. Bednar spoke about “Sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise”.

quotes.text: I pray the Holy Ghost will instruct and enlighten each of us as we consider the importance of ordinances and covenants as spiritual credentials for our journey home to Heavenly Father.
quotes.speaker: Elder David A. Bednar
quotes.talk: Sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: I begin with a short story. Once a man wanted to visit family members in a distant country. He planned his trip, packed his suitcase, and traveled by airplane to the city where his relatives lived.
quotes.speaker: Elder David A. Bednar
quotes.talk: Sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: For disciples of Jesus Christ, receiving priesthood ordinances and entering into sacred covenants are essential steps in the “quest of a lifetime” to align our hearts, minds, and lives with God’s will.
quotes.speaker: Elder David A. Bednar
quotes.talk: Sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The covenants and ordinances of the Savior’s restored gospel are spiritual credentials that can open wide the heavenly windows of opportunity to receive in our lives divine purpose, direction, and strength. God promises His sons and daughters supernal blessings for honoring covenants, including obedience to the laws and ordinances of the gospel of Jesus Christ. Ongoing faithfulness is required for those credentials to be valid and for promised blessings to be received.
quotes.speaker: Elder David A. Bednar
quotes.talk: Sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The Holy Ghost is also described in scripture as the Holy Spirit of Promise, who ratifies or confirms as acceptable to God the righteous acts of His children. Ultimately, all gospel ordinances and covenants must be sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise. As the Lord revealed to the Prophet Joseph Smith, “All covenants … not made and entered into and sealed by the Holy Spirit of promise … are of no efficacy, virtue, or force in and after the resurrection from the dead.”
quotes.speaker: Elder David A. Bednar
quotes.talk: Sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Just as the man in my passport story needed an authorized stamp in his passport to enter a foreign country, so each of us needs the verifying witness of the Holy Spirit of Promise in order for us to receive the eternal blessings associated with the covenants and ordinances of the Savior’s gospel.
quotes.speaker: Elder David A. Bednar
quotes.talk: Sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The sealing of a man and a woman in the house of the Lord is a crowning covenant and ordinance of the Savior’s restored gospel. And importantly, understanding the doctrinal importance of a sealing ordinance being sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise helps to address, in part, deeply personal questions about whether another person’s choices can deprive a faithful covenant keeper of eternal blessings.
quotes.speaker: Elder David A. Bednar
quotes.talk: Sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: The unworthy actions of a spouse certainly bring heartache and sorrow to the other spouse and family members. However, unrighteousness by one person cannot hinder or thwart the flow of God’s love, strength, and blessings to another person. The power of the Lord’s infinite and eternal Atonement can overcome all things, all the time, everywhere, for every person who holds fast to their covenants with Him.
quotes.speaker: Elder David A. Bednar
quotes.talk: Sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise
quotes.session: Sunday Afternoon Session, October 2026 General Conference
